events.quote: Wilhelm Külz ( 18 February 1875 – 10 April 1952 )

events.text: Wilhelm Külz died.

events.quote: 18 February 1875 – 10 April 1952

events.text: He served as interior minister of Germany in the cabinets of chancellors Hans Luther and Wilhelm Marx.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1926 , he served as interior minister of Germany

events.text: Külz was born at Borna near Leipzig in the Kingdom of Saxony.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Külz was born on 18 February 1875 at Borna near Leipzig in the Kingdom of Saxony

events.text: Külz married Erna Freymond.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Külz married Erna Freymond ( 1881–1963 ) in 1901

events.text: Külz was awarded a doctorate at the Staatswissenschaftliche Fakultät of the University of Tübingen.
events.subject: self
events.object: Staatswissenschaftliche Fakultät of the University of Tübingen
events.quote: Also in 1901 , he was awarded a doctorate at the Staatswissenschaftliche Fakultät of the University of Tübingen

events.text: Külz became mayor of Bückeburg and president of the Landtag of the Principality of Schaumburg-Lippe.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1904 , he became mayor of Bückeburg and president of the Landtag of the Principality of Schaumburg-Lippe

events.text: Külz worked on establishing self-government in German South-West Africa.
events.subject: self
events.quote: where he worked on establishing self-government in 1907 to 1908

events.text: Külz's work on establishing self-government in German South-West Africa ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: where he worked on establishing self-government in 1907 to 1908

events.text: Külz was a Reichstag candidate for the National Liberals but was not elected.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Külz was a Reichstag candidate for the National Liberals in 1912 but was not elected

events.text: Külz was elected Oberbürgermeister (mayor) of Zittau.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The same year , he was elected Oberbürgermeister ( mayor ) of Zittau

events.text: Külz's office as Oberbürgermeister of Zittau ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: an office that he held until 1923

events.text: Külz joined the German Democratic Party (DDP).
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1919 , he joined the German Democratic Party ( DDP )

events.text: Külz began representing the DDP in the Reichstag.
events.subject: self
events.quote: from 1922 to 1932 in the Reichstag

events.text: Külz's representation in the Reichstag ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: from 1922 to 1932 in the Reichstag

events.text: Külz was elected as 2. Bürgermeister of Dresden.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1923 , he was elected as 2 . Bürgermeister of Dresden

events.text: Külz began serving as Reichsminister des Innern.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1926 to 1927 , Külz served as Reichsminister des Innern

events.text: Külz's service as Reichsminister des Innern ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1926 to 1927 , Külz served as Reichsminister des Innern

events.text: Külz was elected Oberbürgermeister of Dresden.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Elected as Oberbürgermeister ( mayor ) of Dresden in 1931

events.text: Külz was removed from office by the Reichskommissar for Saxony.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Külz was removed from office by the Reichskommissar for Saxony in March 1933

events.text: Külz was active as a private entrepreneur until 1945.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Until 1945 , he was active as a private entrepreneur

events.text: Külz founded the Berlin branch of the LDPD.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He founded the Berlin branch of the LDPD in the summer of 1945

events.text: Külz acted as LDPD chairman.
events.subject: self
events.quote: acted as LDPD chairman from November 1945

events.text: Külz and Theodor Heuss were elected co-chairmen of the planned Democratic Party of Germany (DPD).
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 17 March 1947 , in a conference in Rothenburg ob der Tauber Külz and Theodor Heuss were elected co-chairmen of the planned Democratic Party of Germany ( DPD )

events.text: Külz participated in the SED-dominated Deutscher Volkskongress.
events.subject: self
events.quote: participated in SED-dominated Deutscher Volkskongress ( German Peoples Congress for Unity and True Peace ) that took place on 6 December 1947

events.text: Külz refused to attend a session of the united leadership of the DPD.
events.subject: self
events.quote: During a session of the united leadership of the DPD that took place on 18 January 1948 and Külz refused to attend

events.text: Külz was the publisher of the LDPD daily Der Morgen.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From 1945 on , Külz was the publisher of the LDPD daily Der Morgen

events.text: Külz once again was the representative of the LDPD at the Deutscher Volkskongress.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In March 1948 , Külz once again was the representative of the LDPD at the Deutscher Volkskongress

events.text: Külz was found to have died in the night at his Berlin apartment.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On the morning of 10 April 1948 , Külz was found by his party deputy , Arthur Lieutenant , to have died in the night at his Berlin apartment
